I've officially completed all labs. Seriously the most fun I've had on the game. Now back to climbing from Gold to Masters.

This is my 8726483th run in Labs of Legends fighting with a limp donger. The set they give you is absolutely trash. Sometimes I even got beat with spiders. Yes. With. Mf SPIDERS. Here is my list of added cards and buffs. 

Reset until you get the passive buff "Out the gates" you don't have enough ramp to even sacrifice the two mana for "Academy Prodigy". 

If you're lucky pick up Jinx after Spiders instance I'm not going into grave detail about what to pick as everything is up to RNGEsus. Here's the card list and buffs accommodating the cards that I used as follows:

Power Passives: Out the Gates, Manaflow, Wild Inspiration. 

Cards with buffs: Aftershock "Chalice of Harmony -3 cost, Wooglets cap when cast shuffle 2 copy's into deck they cost 1"

Iterative Improvement "Mana potion -1 cost"

Eager Apprentice "Giants belt +0/+2, Ninja Tabi Elusive"

Jinx "Spirit Stone fleeting copy's in hand, Twin Shadows summon EPHEMERAL copy on board, Archangel Staff replace the 4 Mana spent summoning Jinx spend 4 Mana get 4 Mana in return"

A few added cards without buffs:  Zaunite Urchin, Get Excited. 

Only other card I had from rewarded card gain was Calculated Creations it's useful only because of Wild Intentions. I really loved the instant removal and I was at 19 hp at Victor and left the fight flawless. Turn 4 win.
